# logos nogo checkconst for Go and loGo/s packages: a const annotated
# // +checkconst <pkg> <obj> is checked against the producer's real typed
# facts through the production driver. A wrong literal fails at the exact
# original line with got/wanted under [nogo::checkconst]; matching and
# unannotated consts stay silent; logos build and plain go build run no
# nogo; --json-diagnostics carries the same mismatch as schema 1.0.
# Helper lives at $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo; behavior only, no source wiring.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# Go: the wrong literal fails at its original Go line with got/wanted, while
# the matching and unannotated consts in the same file stay silent. The lint
# writes no binary and never mentions an eject temp.
cd goconst
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:5:.*\[nogo::checkconst\]'
stderr 'got value "43", wanted "42"'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::checkconst\]'
! stderr 'main\.go:7:'
! stderr 'main\.go:9:'
! stderr 'eject'
! stderr 'virtual'
! exists goconst
! exists goconst$GOEXE
# logos build and go build run no nogo on the same module.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/goconst$GOEXE .
! stderr .
go build -o $WORK/bin/goconst-go$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# loGo/s: the same mismatch maps to the original .lgo line, never the eject
# temp or generated-only paths.
cd lgoconst
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:5:.*\[nogo::checkconst\]'
stderr 'got value "43", wanted "42"'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::checkconst\]'
! stderr 'main\.lgo:7:'
! stderr 'main\.lgo:9:'
! stderr 'eject'
! stderr 'virtual'
! stderr '_logos'
! exists lgoconst
! exists lgoconst$GOEXE
# logos build runs compiler lints only, no nogo.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoconst$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# Matching and unannotated consts alone pass lint and build clean.
cd constok
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos build -o $WORK/bin/constok$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# Malformed and conflicting directives fail at their original Go lines: a
# single-token annotation is potentially malformed, and two resolving
# annotations that disagree report multiple conflicting values.
cd constbad
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:5:.*\[nogo::checkconst\]'
stderr 'potentially malformed checkconst directives'
stderr 'main\.go:8:.*\[nogo::checkconst\]'
stderr 'multiple conflicting values'
stderr -count=2 '\[nogo::checkconst\]'
! stderr 'eject'
! stderr 'virtual'
! exists constbad
! exists constbad$GOEXE
# logos build runs no nogo on the same module.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/constbad$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# --json-diagnostics prints the mismatch as one schema-1.0 object at the
# original Go file with deny severity; no # header and no eject temp.
cd goconst
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"schema_version":"1\.0"'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::checkconst"'
stderr '"severity":"deny"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.go"'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":5,'
stderr 'got value [^,]*43[^,]*, wanted [^,]*42'
stderr '"provenance":'
stderr '"autofix_candidates":\[\]'
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

-- goconst/go.mod --
module example.com/goconst

go 1.27

-- goconst/consts/consts.go --
// Package consts provides the checked constant.
package consts

const Answer = 42

-- goconst/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/goconst/consts"

const Check = 43 // +checkconst consts Answer

const Match = 42 // +checkconst consts Answer

const Plain = 99

func main() {
	println(Check, Match, Plain, consts.Answer)
}

-- lgoconst/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoconst

go 1.27

-- lgoconst/consts/consts.lgo --
// Package consts provides the checked constant.
package consts

const Answer = 42

-- lgoconst/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/lgoconst/consts"

const Check = 43 // +checkconst consts Answer

const Match = 42 // +checkconst consts Answer

const Plain = 99

func main() {
	println(Check, Match, Plain, consts.Answer)
}

-- constok/go.mod --
module example.com/constok

go 1.27

-- constok/consts/consts.go --
// Package consts provides the checked constant.
package consts

const Answer = 42

-- constok/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/constok/consts"

const Check = 42 // +checkconst consts Answer

const Plain = 7

func main() {
	println(Check, Plain, consts.Answer)
}

-- constbad/go.mod --
module example.com/constbad

go 1.27

-- constbad/consts/consts.go --
// Package consts provides the checked constants.
package consts

const Answer = 42

const Other = 7

-- constbad/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/constbad/consts"

const Bad = 1 // +checkconst consts

// +checkconst consts Answer
// +checkconst consts Other
const Clash = 42

func main() {
	println(Bad, Clash, consts.Answer)
}
